items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: As I say, at that time you had -- you had Ida Cox.

ctx.x: Yes. Whom do you remember that may have

The Palace Theater? Well, I'll tell you who played there. As I say, at that time you had -- you had Ida Cox. Ida Cox. I'm sure she's in your book too. Ida Cox. And I'll tell you who was with Ida Cox at the time. No, no, it wasn't Ida -- it was some sisters. The Whitman Sisters. The Whitman Sisters. The Whitman Sisters were very famous. They used to come through. You know, all these groups used to travel through. These were shows or revues, or vaudeville, whatever you called them, vaudeville, at that time. But now…

The Whitman Sisters, and let me see who else used to come through Lake Charles. Well, as I told you before, the minstrel shows used to come through there. But these are people that I can remember as a child, coming through.
